## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. For a stacked PR, state its base PR and merge order.

## Verification

- [ ] Run ./scripts/check.sh and report the result.
- [ ] Add/update behavior tests, fixture evidence, and relevant documentation.
- [ ] For model/prompt changes, compare the fixed benchmark and report critical factual errors.
- [ ] Review staged files for private content and secret findings.
- [ ] Request fresh readiness/manual CI for the current head and base; record the checked revisions.

State manual checks and any planned/unverified checks separately. A local pass is not a hosted CI pass.
